Smooths page changes and reinforces the navigation hierarchy. Disable it to remove all additional motion.
These are the global patches applied to all games by default. You can override them for specific games by tapping the gear icon in the games list.

Resolves an issue in Kristal Engine where battle texts (like \'The tutorial begins…?\') don\'t disappear when opening the menu, stacking on top of each other.\n\n⚠️ May occasionally cause minor visual text reloading on screen.
Disabling the Accumulated Text fix may leave old text fragments visible during dialogs in some games.\n\nAre you sure you want to disable it?
Forces the hiding of Android\'s navigation and status bars (immersive mode), allowing the game to use your device\'s full screen.

PC mod shaders often fail and cause a black screen on Android. This patch dynamically converts GLSL syntax to comply with strict OpenGL ES mobile rules.\n\n⚠️ Keep enabled unless the game completely loses color.
Disabling the GLSL ES shaders fix may cause black screens, freezes, or startup errors in most Kristal/LÖVE2D games on Android.\n\nAre you sure you want to disable it?
Injects a transparent virtual gamepad on the screen. Necessary if you don\'t have a physical controller connected.
Many Kristal Engine mods use screen borders designed for fixed PC aspect ratios (4:3). This patch dynamically resizes borders so they don\'t get cut off on modern wide screens.
Android doesn\'t support 16-bit per channel images. This patch automatically converts affected images to 8-bit in memory to prevent crashes or black screens.
LÖVE\'s virtual file search engine (PhysFS) can enter an infinite loop with certain mod paths. This patch imposes a safe limit to prevent crashes.
Prevents the engine from immediately crashing (\'attempt to perform arithmetic on a nil value\') if a mod tries to manipulate the volume of a missing audio file.
